records.source: Vincent was very brave at the doctor's today. I'm proud of him.
records.translation: 文森特今天看醫生時非常勇敢。我以他為榮。

records.source: It must be so thrilling to travel the world like they do... *sigh*...
records.translation: 像他們一樣環遊世界一定非常刺激……*嘆氣*……

records.source: Be brave, Vincent. Think of your father.
records.translation: 勇敢一點，文森特。想想你爸爸。

records.source: Ohhh... My arms feel like gelatin... $s
records.translation: 喔……我的手臂軟得像果凍……$s

records.source: Shhh... he's asleep.
records.translation: 噓……他睡著了。

records.source: Hey! You can't just barge into a private appointment!$u
records.translation: 嘿！你不能就這樣闖進私人診療！$u

records.source: Doctor Harvey? I'm worried about Vincent's height. Isn't he a little short for his age?
records.translation: 哈維醫生？我很擔心文森特的身高。他是不是比同齡孩子矮了一點？

records.source: Vincent hates going to the doctor more than anything, but he'll just have to deal with it.
records.translation: 文森特最討厭看醫生，但他只能面對。

records.source: Erm... Doctor Harvey? This is completely confidential, right?
records.translation: 呃……哈維醫生？這完全是保密的，對吧？

records.source: I like to check in with the local businesses and see how they're doing.
records.translation: 我喜歡拜訪本地商家，看看他們經營得如何。

records.source: I'm here to collect Clint's business tax.
records.translation: 我是來收克林特的營業稅。

records.source: Well, the fish certainly smells fresh this season.
records.translation: 嗯，這一季的魚聞起來確實很新鮮。

records.source: I do all my grocery shopping here.$h
records.translation: 我的日常雜貨都在這裡買。$h

records.source: I'm just here to make sure all of Marnie's business needs are met.
records.translation: 我只是來確保瑪妮生意上的一切需求都得到滿足。

records.source: The library is one of Pelican Town's greatest features. It's funded with the taxes we collect from local business.
records.translation: 圖書館是鵜鶘鎮最出色的設施之一，經費來自我們向本地商家徵收的稅款。

records.source: You know, I've purchased some of my favorite items from this market...
records.translation: 你知道嗎，我有些最喜愛的物品就是在這個市集買的……

records.source: I hope Penny decides to get married some day.
records.translation: 希望潘妮有一天也決定結婚。

records.source: Wow, the tech on this thing is amazing!
records.translation: 哇，這東西的技術太驚人了！

records.source: I'm at work, honey! Don't let the doctor see.
records.translation: 我正在上班，親愛的！別讓醫生看到。

records.source: I'm almost off work...
records.translation: 我快下班了……

records.source: Dad's making good progress on his experiment.
records.translation: 爸爸的實驗進展得很順利。

records.source: It's hard to really grasp the scale of the universe.$8
records.translation: 宇宙的尺度真的很難理解。$8

records.source: Hey! Mom seems to be doing okay without my help. She's a tough lady.
records.translation: 嘿！沒有我幫忙，媽媽似乎也過得不錯。她是個堅強的女人。

records.source: It's nice for you to visit me.$h
records.translation: 你來看我真好。$h

records.source: Hey! A little privacy, please?$a
records.translation: 嘿！可以給我一點隱私嗎？$a

records.source: I wonder if Maru will get married some day?
records.translation: 不知道瑪魯有一天會不會結婚？

records.source: Hi, honey. It's nice of you to visit me at work.$h
records.translation: 嗨，親愛的。你特地來看我上班，真貼心。$h

records.source: Don't worry, I'm using my own money to buy this.
records.translation: 別擔心，我是用自己的錢買這個。

records.source: Hi, honey! I'm just doing some shopping.
records.translation: 嗨，親愛的！我只是來買點東西。

records.source: Can you smell that? The air is so spicy here...
records.translation: 你聞到了嗎？這裡的空氣充滿辛香……

records.source: I have an appointment at the clinic this afternoon.
records.translation: 我今天下午預約了診所。

records.source: I'm going to go inside, I just wanted a quiet moment.
records.translation: 我準備進去了，只是想先安靜待一下。

records.source: I gotta go visit Uncle Doctor today... Great.$7
records.translation: 我今天得去看醫生叔叔……太棒了。$7

records.source: Maybe if all else fails, I'll become a submarine captain. That might be cool.
records.translation: 也許如果其他路都走不通，我可以去當潛水艇船長。那可能很酷。

records.source: Sorry, honey. I'm trying to concentrate here... $7
records.translation: 抱歉，親愛的。我正在努力集中精神……$7

records.source: Vincent seems a little lonely without me around. I used to play with him a lot.
records.translation: 我不在身邊，文森特似乎有點寂寞。我以前常陪他玩。

records.source: Don't tell my mom... but I really just came over for a free lunch.$h
records.translation: 別告訴我媽……其實我只是來吃免費午餐。$h

records.source: I just got out of the doctor's office. Completely healthy and vigorous, just as I expected.$h
records.translation: 我剛從診間出來。完全健康又精力充沛，和我預料的一樣。$h

records.source: Mom seems okay. A little overworked, maybe.
records.translation: 媽媽看起來還好。也許工作有點太累了。

records.source: I'm a healthy boy, doc. Can I go now? This is boring.
records.translation: 醫生，我是個健康的年輕人。現在可以走了嗎？這裡好無聊。

records.source: Nothing like an ice cold Joja Cola on a sopping wet day, huh?#$e#Just kidding. Hehehe.$h
records.translation: 在溼透的日子裡，沒有什麼比冰涼的 Joja 可樂更棒了，對吧？#$e#開玩笑的。嘿嘿嘿。$h
